areas.lens: header-only template correctness: UB and lifetime on error paths, ODR/revision-namespace ABI permutation, exception-ptr/hooks/policy semantics, noexcept-correctness, move/copy and triviality guarantees, silent failure modes (an error observed as success), C++ standard-version portability (C++17/20/23) and compiler differences

areas.area: Unit test suites, harness and single-header generatation
areas.lens: can the suite report a FALSE GREEN (crash counted as pass, exit code ignored, a permutation silently not run, a skipped suite reported ok)? Does the suite actually cover what the docs promise? Are checks order-dependent or timing-flaky?

doc-versus-code drift: a claim the code no longer honours, an example that would not compile or would throw/abort, a documented invariant with no mechanism enforcing it, and stale version/policy statements

areas.area: Build system, packaging, CI and ABI compliance
areas.files: CMakeLists.txt CTestConfig.cmake .ci.cmake .docs.cmake .boostify cmake/** .github/** conan/** abi-compliance/** install_dev_githooks.sh make_reference_docs.py .gitmodules .quickcpplib
areas.lens: build-system correctness: dependency resolution and bootstrap, an option documented but ignored, silent misconfiguration, packaging (conan/vcpkg) drift, CI coverage versus claims, and anything that makes a green build not actually build what is claimed

areas.area: Benchmarks, boostify generators, single-header output and repo metadata
areas.files: benchmark/** boostify/** single-header/** attic/** index.html Readme.md Licence.txt Doxyfile .clang-format .clang-format-ignore .clang-tidy .gitattributes .gitignore .review-lib/** plans/**
